newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy steady to firmer, wheat flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy steady to firmer, wheat flat.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis values were steady to higher on Tuesday while corn positions were mixed. Hard red winter and soft red winter wheat values were steady.
Dealers cited slow movement and sluggish export business.
"Farmers are holding onto their beans. The (export) pipeline is pretty thin," one dealer said.
In export news, Taiwan's Hui Shung Group bought a combined shipment of 38,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Kanematsu at a tender on Tuesday, Taipei traders said.
